scientific_integrity: The claimed universal result is derived analytically; finite numerical checks are supporting tests, not proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One Gaussian probe and one Lanczos quadrature node in exact arithmetic; expected signed bias only, with no high-probability, multistep, non-Gaussian, or roundoff claim. Priority remains qualified because a relevant 2026 preprint could be inspected only in abstract and equivalent classical log-sum-exp results may exist.
title: Sharp one-node Gaussian Lanczos log-determinant bias and a multiplicity crossover
